elasticity_washed.method: OLS log-demand on log real price + trend + Fourier seasonality (HAC)

elasticity_natural.method: OLS log-demand on log real price + trend + Fourier seasonality (HAC)

elasticity_robusta.method: OLS log-demand on log real price + trend + Fourier seasonality (HAC)
